thlb_intensity_screen.proxy: The operable-proxy landbase is a SCANFI merchantability screen intersected with a share-based 2016 tenure proxy. It is not a legal THLB: it carries no slope, road access, age/disturbance, growth, yield, or economic constraint. Intensity caps are screening sensitivities only.

operable_proxy.missing_policy: documented cap retained; flagged operable_missing; no zero substitution

thlb_intensity_screen.national_envelope_note: The national envelope is I * national operable area and ignores provincial documented-cap allocation. It is reported for comparison with the per-province min-cap LP, which is the model of record.

managed_proxy_comparison.status: comparison only; superseded by the operable-proxy screen
managed_proxy_comparison.proxy: The 2016 tenure-union managed proxy (166.28 Mha) is retained only as a comparison basis. It is not a THLB and is superseded by the tighter operable proxy for the intensity screen.

caveats: Upper bounds are a mixed set of statutory AAC, approximate AAC, a repo TSA path, a documented range midpoint, planning volumes, and actual-mean proxies. Their sum is not a national AAC.
NB, NS, and QC AACs are Crown-only; FSD harvest is total provincial harvest. NB private supply is undocumented, so the NB cap is conservative.

The operable-proxy landbase is a SCANFI merchantability screen intersected with a share-based 2016 tenure proxy. It is not a legal THLB and has no slope, road access, age/disturbance, growth, yield, or economic content.
PE and NU have no operable proxy; their documented caps are retained and flagged operable_missing, not set to zero.
The managed-landbase proxy is retained only as a comparison basis and is not used for the intensity screen of record.
The allocation minimizes deviation from 2024 shares. It is not a forecast, a sustainable-supply estimate, or an economic equilibrium.
No harvest, transport, stumpage, silviculture, or forest-sector opportunity cost enters the objective.
